frontMatter.title: This Wednesday: Claremont Stadium Club Night
frontMatter.summary: Two big Grade 6 Mixed fixtures at Claremont this Wednesday: Navan A in a must-win league match vs Ardee, and Navan B in a knockout cup tie vs Athboy/Kells. Members’ courts open from 8:30pm.

prev.title: Monday Club Night: Fixtures, Courts & Juvenile Times
prev.summary: Shake off the Monday blues with Monday Club Night: Navan vs ESB (Division 3 Ladies), Navan vs Longwood ‘B’ (Grade 5 Men’s), 2 member courts from 9pm, plus Juvenile sessions (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).
